item.text: The dispatcher currently promotes Beacon by account and leaves other shipments in queue order. I’m checking the queue’s existing priority semantics and tests so the fix applies across accounts while preserving FIFO ties.

item.text: The queue was comparing priority names alphabetically, so “normal” beat “urgent”; Beacon’s account promotion only hid that bug for Beacon. I’ve switched the queue to the service ranks and removed the account-specific override. I’ll run the dispatch tests now.
